title: Import up to 50 multimodal reference assets (images, videos, audio) in Dreamina…
content:
Import up to 50 multimodal reference assets (images, videos, audio) in Dreamina Seedance 2.5 to lock in consistent product appearance, brand visuals, talent, sound direction, camera style, and overall mood across variations.  
Generate a 30-second continuous clip as a single Seedance 2.5 generation when you need a full ad-length output in one pass.  
Use Seedance 2.5 local editing tools to select precise timestamps, isolate elements, and refine only the specific parts of a video you need to change (e.g., product detail, background element, subject integration, or a specific moment).  
Extend a Seedance 2.5 clip beyond the initial generation using extensions up to 3 minutes to build longer campaign assets from the same base.
